name: campus-web
description: Cloudflare Worker runtime shell for the student-facing campus experience surface.

scripts.build: pnpm docs:build:published-reader && WRANGLER_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_WARNING=1 XDG_CONFIG_HOME=./.wrangler-home vite build && node ../../scripts/check_web_client_bundle_budget.mjs --app apps/campus-web
scripts.build:staging: pnpm docs:build:published-reader:staging && WRANGLER_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_WARNING=1 CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging XDG_CONFIG_HOME=./.wrangler-home node ../../scripts/run-worker-staging-build.mjs -- vite build && node ../../scripts/check_web_client_bundle_budget.mjs --app apps/campus-web
scripts.deploy: pnpm build && pnpm deploy:verify-config && node ../../scripts/run-wrangler-command.mjs deploy --config dist/campus_web/wrangler.json
scripts.docs:build:published-reader: CAMPUS_WEB_RSPRESS_DOCS_ROOT=.generated/docs pnpm docs:sync:published-reader && CAMPUS_WEB_RSPRESS_DOCS_ROOT=.generated/docs rspress build -c rspress.config.ts && node ./scripts/filter-rspress-search-index.mjs && node ./scripts/copy-rspress-docs-build.mjs
scripts.docs:build:published-reader:staging: CAMPUS_WEB_RSPRESS_DOCS_ROOT=.generated/docs pnpm docs:sync:published-reader:staging && CAMPUS_WEB_RSPRESS_DOCS_ROOT=.generated/docs rspress build -c rspress.config.ts && node ./scripts/filter-rspress-search-index.mjs && node ./scripts/copy-rspress-docs-build.mjs
scripts.docs:build:scaffold: pnpm docs:scaffold && rspress build -c rspress.config.ts && node ./scripts/filter-rspress-search-index.mjs && node ./scripts/copy-rspress-docs-build.mjs
scripts.preview: pnpm build && WRANGLER_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_WARNING=1 XDG_CONFIG_HOME=./.wrangler-home vite preview
